title: Adaptive Hybrid Subspace Levenberg Marquardt Algorithm with Adequacy Monitor for Large Scale Least Squares Problems
abstract: arXiv:2608.25524v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) algorithm is the most widely used method for solving nonlinear least-squares problems, as it combines the robustness of steepest descent with the fast local convergence of the Gauss-Newton method. However, its computational cost can become prohibitive for large-scale problems because each iteration requires solving a large damped linear system, and conventional step acceptance strategies may require repeated solves as the damping parameter is adjusted. translated_title: 自适应混合子空间列文伯格-马夸尔特算法及充分性监测器用于大规模最小二乘问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25524v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：列文伯格-马夸尔特（LM）算法是求解非线性最小二乘问题最广泛使用的方法，因为它结合了最速下降法的鲁棒性和高斯-牛顿法的快速局部收敛性。然而，对于大规模问题，其计算成本可能变得过高，因为每次迭代需要求解一个大型阻尼线性系统，并且传统的步长接受策略可能需要在调整阻尼参数时进行重复求解。尽管存在这一计算挑战，许多大规模最小二乘问题表现出有效的低维结构，只有少数参数空间方向被数据强烈约束。我们提出了一种自适应混合子空间列文伯格-马夸尔特（HSLM）算法，该算法从梯度、记忆、Krylov子空间和随机曲率信息的互补来源构建低维子空间，并计算谱阻尼步。
tldr: 本文提出一种自适应混合子空间LM算法，通过结合多种低维信息源构建子空间并采用谱阻尼，显著降低大规模最小二乘问题的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive hybrid subspace Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm that constructs a low-dimensional subspace from diverse information sources with spectral damping, significantly reducing computational cost for large-scale least-squares problems.
